LanguageData.RealityWeaver_ToggleDesc: Toggle the Reality Weaver on or off. When active, every Rare Tick it will instantly construct all building blueprints and construction frames within the target area, consuming power equal to their total work amount.
LanguageData.RealityWeaver_SelectAreaDesc: Choose which allowed area the weaver monitors for pending blueprints and construction frames (current: {0}).
LanguageData.RealityWeaver_Disabled: Reality Weaver: disabled (toggle on to activate).
LanguageData.RealityWeaver_Status: Pending: {0} blueprint(s) / frame(s) · Cost: {1} Wd · Area: {2}
LanguageData.RealityWeaver_SmoothSurfaceDesc: Automatically complete all planned floor and wall smoothing tasks on the current map
LanguageData.RealityWeaver_OkSmoothSurface: Auto smoothing completed! Processed {0} areas in a flash

LanguageData.RealityWeaver_PaintDesc: Instantly complete all planned floor painting tasks on the current map (no materials required)

LanguageData.RealityWeaver_RemovePaintOk: Automatically completed {0} floor paint removal tasks
LanguageData.RealityWeaver_CompleteAllDesc: Instantly complete all pending blueprints and construction frames in the target area. This will consume power as usual.
